notes.title: Full release of the Sapper - Defuse The Bomb Simulator
notes.content:

[h3][b]Sapper - Defuse The Bomb Simulator[/b] is finally leaving Early Acces![/h3]

[b]We are proud to finally say that we have completed work on our game. [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1083070/Sapper__Defuse_The_Bomb_Simulator/

[list]
[*] New system for defusing large bombs
[*] New map: Canals
[*] More story-driven missions
[*] New mechanics: Sapper Vision
[*] New explosive types: pipe bomb (Pipe Bomb) and Booby Trap with new mechanics
[*] Mode for daltonists
[*] Improved visual side of the game
[*] New bomb placement
[*] Bug fixes
[*] Notes to find during the game
[/list]

notes.title: City Level Design
notes.content:
[h3]Sappers![/h3]

We have a city to defuse!

Okay, this is low hanging reference fruit, but it suits today's Devlog subject well.
The City map is currently in the redesign and enhancement process with new stories, mechanics and level design. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35037085/9df3125fc8d99ee68c8582a0147a2a1af48393d9.png[/img]

The idea is to implement more platformers-like moments where you have to jump, climb, avoid obstacles, look for on / off switches to unlock the path.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35037085/5b7970a7eb4ae98dd071ef63bf5763b281e7d582.png[/img]

Some of the new mechanics are distance-based mini bombs that activate when you walk nearby. Defusing those explosives now varies from the main objective bombs and will reveal information about the antagonist, which story and persona we rewrote.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35037085/241ab6a645d6479fa085bac6ae958c6597fac844.png[/img]

The level will receive more details and clutter to enhance storytelling further. Here is a cosy place where workers hid from their boss and allowed the bomber to sneak into the construction site.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35037085/c0c5a27cd1dac49199417ff73aa33f01e4e2c94a.png[/img]

Overall we aim to make the game more intense and faster by adding things like zip lines to move across the level and more variety of explosive dangers, as we have mentioned [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1083070/view/3066381328911319880]in the previous Devlog[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35037085/65caa8b6b923ba1488e8df27d1d2643233c8b838.png[/img]

More news is coming soon. Stay tuned, stay frosty.
Yours "Sapper - Defuse the Bomb Simulator" Team.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1083070/Sapper__Defuse_The_Bomb_Simulator/
[url=https://discord.gg/dgg5pyfn5z][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35037085/d1d6d1443ca0d5942b440ae247d5c2ac02226474.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Status Update
notes.content:
[h3]Sappers!
[/h3]
Patience and persistence are the hallmarks of a seasoned specialist, especially those whose mistakes neighbourhood kilometres away can hear. It stays true to the game dev as well.

Sapper - Defuse the Bomb Simulator Full Release version is constantly in development. We received a tremendous amount of feedback after the Early Access Release that allows us to address what's good and wrong.

We would love to thank all those who sent us their feedback. You guys are the best!

There are a few main goals we want to archive:

[olist]
[*]Redesign currently used defusing minigames.
[*]Add more levels and improve presently existing.
[*]Improve or change now used lockpicking, hacking and decrypting minigames.
[*]Add new mechanics to the game
[/olist]
Those are some severe changes in the game, so they will most definitely break current saves of the game. Don't worry, though. We will make it worthwhile to start over.

The new defusing mechanics will be much more complex and engaging, with more room to make loud mistakes. Below we have a design art showcasing the new bomb-defusing minigame.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35037085/c9d975040ab89ef62e7247f694edb422f5aedf77.png[/img]

Many of the players enjoyed searching for bombs in various environments by resolving environmental puzzles. Upcoming map changes emphasize those elements by adding more complex routes to reach the bomb or other story essential items and clues. We will talk about it more thoroughly in the next Devlog that we will post regularly from now on :)

Meanwhile, we are adding new mechanics, so fellow sappers will have to work harder for their wages.
One of those is laser emitters. They...well...emit lasers. No sapper ever want to cross those.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35037085/c8d0596b29fd3a7bfa2749a64a1ecb29af62bcc7.png[/img]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35037085/ee71af926d1571728efc8a6a25e0a2f152de7e2d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35037085/74f87e8822e33e127c44c00c18740875b9d0b6d8.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35037085/e19822ce38b6ea2e3e12da5343d1a2e1caeeff5e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35037085/be5814d4a37559a464df44e556c427f3c6759e0b.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35037085/90cc027723e9e7a3fdf6d7da91f4c3ed6a369d58.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35037085/9e13f29326816c07eccc9c371fe75eefdf720d1e.png[/img][/url]

They are to appear in part of the mission and will be a form of an obstacle for the player. 
Lasers will be able to move on the surface and the emitter, placed on the gimbal, capable of moving in two axes...

More news is coming in the next Devlog in two weeks.
Yours "Sapper - Defuse the Bomb Simulator" Team.
[url=https://discord.gg/dgg5pyfn5z][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35037085/d1d6d1443ca0d5942b440ae247d5c2ac02226474.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Sapper - Defuse The Bomb Simulator - Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
[h1][b]Dear Sappers![/b][/h1]

[h1]We're not blasting off yet - instead we're happy to introduce the next set of changes![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35037085/693dae52996489a6d71edf56fdb5626c2191fdda.png[/img]

We are happy to see that the initial wave of changes and bugfixes was welcomed by you positively! 

This time we would like to communicate another list of changes that we've introduced into our game - we'll do our best to make sure you're well equipped to defuse even the biggest of bombs! 

[b]Find the list of the changes below:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed environment bugs (spots where you can get stuck easily, wrong position of objects, colliders and hit boxes)
[*] Language corrections
[*] Cables on bombs are now even more color-blind friendly. Now we have colors which are easy to distinguish and half of them is also additionally overriden by patterns.
[*] Dialogues now take 1.5 seconds longer - no need to rush, unless you're dealing with the bombs themselves
[*] Fixed bug with bomb cables which in some cases could be interacted while whole bomb was not available for us yet or we didn't click on it
[*] Fixed bug with lever going crazy inside power generator on forest map
[*] Added auto turn off flashlight on pillars in the city scene
[*] Deleted few forest quests which appeared to be a little bit boring
[*] Fixed bugs with setting resolution, field of view and sound.
[*] Fixed blur glitch on mine tutorial in office
[*] Fixed size of headers in settings within russian language
[/list]
Once again we would like to thank you for your feedback and again we ask you to keep on sending us all suggestions, bug reports and ideas for our game! Early Access is the best place for just that! 

Best regards,
Sapper - Defuse The Bomb Simulator Team

[url=https://discord.gg/WWDM2Bx][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493800/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Sapper - Defuse The Bomb Simulator - Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
[h1][b]Dear Sappers![/b][/h1]

[h1]With the wave of feedback we received from you come fixes and patches![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35037085/1c89efb858ebb97885616a2f00e372709269b8ec.png[/img]

Thank you very much for playing Sapper - Defuse The Bomb Simulator. We are happy to see you eager to save the city and defuse as many bombs as possible. 

In order to make it easier for you we've been hard at work preparing patches and updates for the game and we hope your job as a Sapper will be so much more comfortable with the changes we introduced into the game. 

[b]Find the list of the changes below:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed various compass issues
[*] Fixed various environment bugs
[*] Fixed a particular nasty bug causing death while jumping from high place without the bomb in hand
[*] Increased hacking time for each perk level
[*] Jumping to the balcony in city made easier
[*] [u]Color of cables on bombs are now more color-blind friendly[/u] - we'll be gradually making the game more accessible during next patches
[*] Fixed pointing to ATM
[*] Minor translation corrections
[/list]
We hope you will have a great time with our game and keep the feedback coming! We're here to listen and make sure the game is as fun as physically possible! 

Best regards,
Sapper - Defuse The Bomb Simulator Team
